text:
**My pick: the Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with a 200W panel, $699 (list $879).** It has the best mix of power, price and track record in these results: 1,070Wh LiFePO4 battery, 1,500W AC output, about a 1-hour fast charge from a wall outlet, and 4.5 stars from 1.4K reviews on Amazon. Talk of the House also named it its editor's choice. [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

Two caveats: the 1-hour charge needs app activation, and the 200W panel takes roughly 6-8 hours of good sun to refill it ([Talk of the House](https://www.talkofthehouse.com/best-solar-generator-kits-with-panels/)). That review also says panels may ship separately, so check your order.

**Other good options, by need:**
- **Similar size, similar price:** [EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic with 220W panel](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels), $699 (list $1,099), 1,024Wh, 1,800W, 4.6 stars. [Top Consumer Reviews](https://www.topconsumerreviews.com/best-solar-generators/detailed-reviews.php) ranks EcoFlow #1 overall, citing the app, expandability and fast 10ms UPS switchover.
- **Same size, lowest list price:** [BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 with 200W panel](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels), $699 (list $999), 1,024Wh, 1,800W.
- **Home backup (fridge, several appliances):** [Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with 2x200W panels](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included), $1,399, 2,042Wh, 2,200W, 4.6 stars. For more capacity, the [BLUETTI Elite 300 with 2x200W panels](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels) is $1,599.99 for 3,014Wh.
- **Costco members:** [Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 with a solar panel](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html), $899.99 online. It was out of stock at the Mountain View warehouse, but delivery was available.
- **Tight budget:** [UDPOWER S1200 with 120W panel](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included), $549.99, 1,190Wh. It has fewer reviews (41) and a lower rating (4.1), so it's a riskier buy.

Prices come from the search listings and may have changed. Check the product page before you order.

One search result, a coupon page for the ALLPOWERS P1800, told me to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link. I left it out. It wasn't part of your request, and that listing doesn't include a solar panel anyway.

If you tell me what you want to power (CPAP, fridge, camping gear) and your budget, I can narrow this to one model.
